limits: The pinned recursive tree is complete (25,329 entries, not truncated); this continuation deep-inspected and hashed selected files only, not the full repository.

Other skill entrypoints, linked support files, hook adapters, prompt/tool manifests, and much of the broader runtime remain indexed-only; external links and the full transitive dependency closure were not independently reviewed.
